title: Travis Walton abduction two weeks after NBC's The UFO Incident
summary: Bryce tells of Travis Walton abduction two weeks after NBC's The UFO Incident, about 1975 at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: not that great. But what happens two weeks after the UFO incident, uh, Travis Walton gets abducted.

plain: A researcher named Bryce, on Jesse Michels's podcast about Hollywood and UFOs, points to timing in 1975. He says that NBC aired The UFO Incident, a TV film starring James Earl Jones based on The Interrupted Journey, a book about a couple who said they were abducted, and that two weeks later a man named Travis Walton said he was abducted himself. Bryce raises it to suggest a link between what appears on screen and what people then report.
